Class ViewCreateLesson

java.lang.Object
guiCreateLesson.ViewCreateLesson
public class ViewCreateLesson extends Object

Title: ViewCreateLesson Class.

Description: The JavaFX-based Create Lesson View. This class displays the Lesson Details and Experience sections and forwards submitted values to the Controller for validation and storage.

    • displayCreateLesson

      public static void displayCreateLesson(javafx.stage.Stage owner, entityClasses.User user, Runnable onCreated)

      Method: displayCreateLesson()

      Description: Displays the Create Lesson form using the Contributor sage theme and connects its actions to the Create Lesson Controller.

      Parameters:
      owner - Contributor Home window that owns this form
      user - active contributor creating the lesson
      onCreated - operation used to refresh the Contributor Home page

    • showMessage

      protected static void showMessage(javafx.stage.Stage owner, String title, String message, boolean error)

      Method: showMessage()

      Description: Displays a styled success or error message associated with the Create Lesson form.

      Parameters:
      owner - form that owns the message window
      title - message-window title
      message - information displayed to the contributor
      error - true when the message reports an error
